# Inspector NextGen

Rasa's modular frontend inspection tool. Embeds into Studio 2.0, Hello, and Pro.

## What this folder is

- **Entry point**: `src/Inspector/Inspector.tsx` (library export); SPA shell via `src/main.tsx` + `src/App.tsx`
- **State**: `@tanstack/store` via `store/` — all mutations through named actions in
  `store/actions.ts`
- **Design system**: Chakra UI v3 — use `textStyle`, `colorPalette`, and semantic tokens;
  never raw `fontSize`, `fontFamily`, or hex values
- **Build targets**: `/lib` (npm package → Studio 2.0, Hello) and `/spa` from `/dist` (→ Pro).
  Initialisation differs between the two.
- **Consumers (read-only)**: `/lib` is `@rasahq/rasa-inspector`. Studio —
  https://github.com/RasaHQ/studio (`web-client`); Hello —
  https://github.com/RasaHQ/hello. Open those only when verifying lib entry/init
  changes; do not hardcode host paths or auth into Inspector.

## Rules and conventions

Full coding rules: `.claude/rules/inspector-frontend.md` (repo root)
Planning / review agent: `.claude/agents/inspector-frontend.md` (repo root)

## Tests

- Unit tests: Vitest, use `renderWithProviders` from test helpers
- E2E: Playwright under `e2e/` — **read `e2e/CLAUDE.md` first** before writing or modifying
  E2E tests (worked examples: `e2e/docs/authoring-tests.md`)
- Every PR must include a `## Manual test plan` section in the PR body

## Dev loop

Use `.claude/hooks/inspector-dev.sh` to start the dev server (do not run `yarn dev` manually).
Pre-commit runs `yarn build:spa` — before that, always run `nvm use && yarn` after pulling or
merging from main.
